abstract: Malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary is rare, and occurs in approximately 2% of all cases. The most common malignancy arising in mature cystic teratoma is squamous cell carcinoma. Sarcomas very rarely develop in mature cystic teratoma. We describe the case of a 65-year-old patient with mature cystic teratoma, and with rhabdomyosarcomatous transformation and contralateral serous carcinoma. To our knowledge, this is the first case of a pure rhabdomyosarcoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical findings of this exceptional case are reported and the literature is reviewed.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は約2%と稀である。最も多い悪性腫瘍は扁平上皮癌であり、肉腫が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じることはきわめて稀である。今回、65歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に横紋筋肉腫様の悪性転化と対側の漿液性癌を認めた症例を報告する。純粋な横紋筋肉腫が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた例は、本例が初めてと考えられる。本症例の臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的所見を報告し、文献をレビューした。
